_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Energy Monitoring and Control Systems (EMCS) Factory Test Plan
summary: The Factory Test Plan defines all tests required to ensure the EMCS meets technical, operational, and performance requirements and supports in-process review of factory testing.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Factory Test Plan defines all the tests required to ensure that the EMCS meets technical, operational, and performance requirements.

3.2 The Factory Test Plan will be used for an in-process review of the factory testing to ensure that the proper tests, procedures, and equipment are used for the Factory Test.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the Factory Test Plans required by paragraph 4.2 of MIL-STD-2202A.

7.2 This DID is related to DI-ATTS-80361A, EMCS Factory Test Procedures; and DI-ATTS-80362A, EMCS Factory Test Reports.

7.3 This DID supersedes DI-ATTS-80360.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Factory Test Plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The test plan shall contain the following:

children.title: I/O summary tables with failure modes for test points.
Required passwords for each operator access level.
Description of each type of digital I/O and analog I/O to be used in the test data base.
Surge and overvoltage protection circuits diagrams.
For each application program shown in the I/O summary table, the plan shall include:
Inputs required for each program (I/O point values and status) and corresponding expected results for each set of input values.
Default values for the program inputs not implemented or provided for in the contract documents for the application programs to be tested.
Failure modes for each I/O function to be tested.
Identification of simulation programs, equipment, personnel, and facilities required.
Identification of capabilities and functions to be tested, including values and situations that comprise the test.
Identification of all areas where physical and functional details of the system to be tested differ from the generic system, including explanations of the differences.
